analysis:
Broadcom fell 10.3%, roughly in line with its AI compute peers (median -10.2%) and 0.5 points less than the SMH benchmark, though 5.9 points more than the broader market. The headlines point to a severe sector-wide selloff: "The AI Trade Just Had Its Worst Day Since The Pandemic," chip stocks facing AI regulation fears per The Wall Street Journal, Nvidia down nearly $1.4 trillion from its October record, and Micron sinking 17%. The coverage collectively describes a broad collapse across AI and semiconductor names rather than company-specific news for Broadcom, with Marvell reportedly down 49% over the past month.

The company reports earnings in 34 days on December 9. Broadcom's recent earnings history shows volatile reactions even after beating estimates: the median abnormal move beyond the market is 7.1%, and three of seven beats in the sample were followed by negative abnormal moves, including a -13.5 point drop in June 2026 despite a 1.7% earnings surprise and a -9.4 point fall in December 2025 after a 4.4% beat.
